_comment: Copy to apply-profile.json (git-ignored), or let `node auto-apply.mjs --setup` write it. Everything is optional. 'standard' answers the questions most forms ask (allowed values: run --setup). 'answers' covers anything else: it picks a dropdown option or types text when a form question's label CONTAINS 'question' (case-insensitive) and wins over 'standard'. Unanswered questions are listed for you to answer by hand.
